caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular design with a black background and features a symmetrical, decorative composition of floral and foliage motifs. At the center is a large red flower with a yellow center, surrounded by three clusters of green leaves. To the bottom left of the central flower, there is a solid red circular shape with small blue leaves beneath it. On either side of the central flower, there are peach-yellow curved bands that spiral inward, creating mirror images of each other, and each enclosing additional decorative elements. Inside each curved band, to the left and right, is a cluster of smaller red flowers and leaves, with three more prominent green leaves in each segment. There are also two smaller yellow flowers positioned symmetrically on either side of the central motif. The overall color palette is dominated by reds, greens, peach-yellows, and black, with some blue accents. The floral elements and curved bands fill the space within the rectangular border.
title: Rug
